nodes.name: Build Apify Query
nodes.notes: Emits one query per inventory unit. It used to read $json and scan only the first of twelve.

nodes.name: Parse AI Price
nodes.notes: Runs once per item. In all-items mode it read $json and parsed exactly one of sixteen scraped pages; .first() also mispaired the metadata. Prefers schema.org JSON-LD over the model, and takes the source from the page hostname, which always exists.

fieldValues.fieldValue: ={{ $json.competitorPrice === null ? 'No competitor price found' : ($json.priceDiff < 0 ? 'UNDERCUT: competitor is AED ' + Math.abs($json.priceDiff) + ' cheaper. Consider matching, especially at ' + $json.daysInStock + ' days in stock.' : 'HOLD: we are already AED ' + $json.priceDiff + ' cheaper than this competitor.') }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ workflow: 'Competitor Price Scraping', status: ($json.delivery ? $json.delivery.status : ($json.skipReason ? 'REJECTED' : 'SUCCESS')), lead_name: null, lead_email: null, summary: ($json.skipReason ? ('Scrape produced no usable intel for ' + ($json.model || 'a unit') + ' — ' + $json.skipReason) : ('Competitor price recorded for ' + ($json.model || 'a unit'))) + ($json.delivery ? ' | ' + $json.delivery.note : ''), logged_at: $now.toUTC().toISO() }) }}
